comparison_sets.description: Identify which helicity-basis phase-space region gives the largest top-quark discord and therefore the strongest observed basic quantum correlation.
Identify which helicity-basis phase-space region is most entangled according to the Peres-Horodecki marker.
Identify which helicity-basis region provides the strongest steering signal and the best evidence for steerability.
Identify the helicity-basis region closest to the CHSH Bell-correlation threshold.
Identify which helicity-basis phase-space region has the largest mixed-state magic.
Identify which beam-basis phase-space region gives the largest top-quark discord in the bona fide spin-state basis.
Identify which beam-basis phase-space region is most entangled according to the Peres-Horodecki marker.
Identify which beam-basis region gives the largest steering marker.
Identify which beam-basis region lies closest to the CHSH Bell-correlation threshold.
Identify which beam-basis phase-space region has the largest mixed-state magic.
